info.name: RozFM Admin Panel API Collection
info.description: Complete standalone Postman collection for RozFM Admin Panel APIs including Dashboard, User Management, Content Management (Stories/Episodes), Categories, Banners, Monetization, Content Moderation, Push Notifications, and System Settings.

request.description: Authenticate an administrator user using email and password to receive a JWT access token.

Fetch overall metrics (total users, active stories, episodes, play counts, revenue, recent registrations, and top stories).

Fetch paginated users with optional filters by search term, role (Listener/Creator/Admin), or block status.
Fetch complete profile of a single user along with overview metrics, wallet transactions, listening history, premium status, devices, and reports.

Fetch User Wallet & Coins tab transactions list.
Fetch User Listening History tab data (stories played, genre, episodes played, last played timestamp).
Fetch User Premium Status tab data (active membership plan, renewal date, remaining billing days).
Fetch User Devices & Logins tab data (device name, OS version, login location, last login time).
Fetch User Moderation Reports tab data.
Create a new user account from the Admin Panel with role, plan, and initial status.
Update user details, subscription plan, locale, role, password (optional), or suspend/ban status.
Permanently delete a user account by ID.
Credit (+) or Debit (-) coin balance in a user's wallet with a custom description/reason.

item.name: 14. Creator Analytics
item.description: Aggregate performance analytics across the entire creator base — active creators, avg earnings, new creator growth, and monthly earnings paid-out chart data for the Admin panel.

query.description: Number of months of earnings-paid-out chart data to return (1–24, default 12)

request.description:
Returns aggregate creator analytics for the Admin panel:

**KPI Cards:**
- `active_creators` — total active (non-blocked) creators + last month count + MoM change %
- `avg_earnings_per_creator` — average INR earnings per active creator (based on paid withdrawals; falls back to gross writer_earnings)
- `new_creators` — creators joined this calendar month + last month count + MoM change %

**Line Chart:**
- `earnings_paid_out_chart` — array of monthly totals (paid withdrawals) for the last N months, zero-filled for months with no data
- Each item: `{ month, month_label, amount, formatted_amount, payout_count }`

**MoM change object shape:**
```json
{
  "percentage": 6.2,
  "is_positive": true,
  "direction": "up",
  "text": "+6.2% vs last month"
}
```

**Auth required:** Admin Bearer token

response.name: 200 OK — Creator Analytics

query.description: Fetch last 6 months of chart data

request.description: Same as the main Creator Analytics endpoint but returns only the last 6 months of earnings-paid-out chart data. Use `months=6` for a shorter date range view.

query.description: Fetch last 24 months (max) of chart data for a 2-year earnings trend

request.description: Same as the main Creator Analytics endpoint but returns the maximum 24 months of earnings-paid-out chart data for a 2-year trend view.

item.name: 15. Creator Withdrawal Management
item.description: Manage withdrawal payout requests submitted by creators. Supports listing with search/status filters, viewing request details, approving, rejecting, and marking as paid.

query.description: Search by creator name, email, phone, bank account number, or UPI ID
Filter by status: all | pending | approved | paid | success | rejected

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of creator withdrawal requests for the Admin panel Creator Withdrawals screen.

**Response includes:**
- `withdrawals[]` — each item has creator info, amount (formatted INR), payment method (UPI / Bank Transfer), status, requested date
- `summary` — aggregate counts and totals for pending, approved, paid, rejected
- `pagination` — total, page, limit, total_pages

**Status values:**
- `pending` — submitted, awaiting admin action
- `approved` — approved, payment not yet confirmed
- `paid` / `success` — payment confirmed (frontend can show either label)
- `rejected` — request rejected

**Auth required:** Admin Bearer token

request.description:
Generic action endpoint to update a creator withdrawal request status.

**Body fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | ✅ | `approved`, `paid`, `rejected`, `pending` |
| `transaction_reference` | string | ⚠️ | Required/recommended when approving or marking as paid |
| `utr` | string | — | Alias for `transaction_reference` |
| `admin_notes` | string | — | Internal admin note |
| `rejection_reason` | string | ✅ when rejecting | Mandatory if status = rejected |

**Shortcut endpoints available:**
- `POST /creator-withdrawals/:id/approve` — sets status to `approved` automatically
- `POST /creator-withdrawals/:id/reject` — sets status to `rejected` automatically (still requires `rejection_reason` in body)

response.name: 200 OK — Approved

request.description:
Shortcut endpoint to approve a creator withdrawal — automatically sets `status = approved`. Optionally provide `transaction_reference` and `admin_notes`.

Maps to the **Approve** button in the Creator Withdrawals list.

Shortcut endpoint to reject a creator withdrawal — automatically sets `status = rejected`.

**`rejection_reason` is required** in the request body. It will be visible to the creator in their withdrawal history.

Optionally include `admin_notes` for internal records.

response.name: 200 OK — Rejected
422 — rejection_reason missing

item.name: 16. Published Stories
item.description: Lists stories that have been approved by admin (is_approved = 'Approved'). Also includes approve, reject, and generic approval-status update actions for any story.

query.description: Search by story title or creator name

request.description:
Returns all creator stories where `is_approved = 'Approved'`.

Matches the **Published Stories** screen in the Admin Creator Panel.

**Response columns:**
- `title` — story title
- `cover_image` — resolved CDN URL
- `creator` — creator name, avatar, email
- `episodes_count` — total episodes
- `total_plays` / `formatted_plays` — play count (e.g. 1.2M)
- `is_approved` — always `"Approved"` in this list

**Summary block:**
- `total_published`, `total_pending`, `total_rejected`

**Auth required:** Admin Bearer token

> **Note:** Run the migration SQL first to add `is_approved` column:
> `ALTER TABLE stories ADD COLUMN is_approved ENUM('Pending','Approved','Rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending';`

item.name: 17. Pending Stories
item.description: Creator story submissions awaiting editorial review. Admin can approve or reject with remarks. Both actions persist admin_remarks in the stories table.

query.description: Search by story title or creator name

request.description:
Returns all creator stories where `is_approved = 'Pending'`.

Matches the **Pending Stories** screen — STORY | CREATOR | SUBMITTED | Actions (Dismiss / Take Action).

**Response fields per story:**
- `id`, `title`, `cover_image`, `category`, `language`
- `creator` — `{ id, name, avatar, email }`
- `submitted_date` — formatted (e.g. `22 Jul 2026`)
- `is_approved` — always `"Pending"` in this list
- `admin_remarks` — any previous admin note

**Summary block:** `total_approved`, `total_pending`, `total_rejected`

> **Run migration first:**
> ```sql
> ALTER TABLE stories ADD COLUMN is_approved ENUM('Pending','Approved','Rejected') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Pending' AFTER status;
> ALTER TABLE stories ADD COLUMN admin_remarks TEXT NULL DEFAULT NULL AFTER is_approved;
> ```

**The admin remarks are stored in the `admin_remarks` DB column.**

**Body fields:**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `remarks` | string | Optional | Admin approval note. Also accepted as `admin_remarks` or `note` |

Accepts both `POST` and `PUT`.

request.description:

**`remarks` is REQUIRED** — it is stored in the `admin_remarks` DB column and returned in the response.

**Accepted body keys:** `remarks`, `admin_remarks`, `rejection_reason`, or `note`.

Accepts both `POST` and `PUT`.

response.name: 200 OK — Story Rejected

request.description:
Generic approval status update — accepts `Approved`, `Rejected`, or `Pending`.

**Body:**
| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `status` | string | ✅ | `Approved`, `Rejected`, `Pending` |
| `remarks` | string | ✅ when `Rejected` | Stored in `admin_remarks` DB column |

Use `/approve` and `/reject` shortcut endpoints for one-click actions.

item.name: 19. Ad Reward Settings
item.description:
Admin panel endpoints to configure the 'Watch Ads to Earn' feature.

Controls:
- **coins_per_ad** — coins awarded per single ad watch (default 1)
- **max_ads_per_day** — daily ad reward cap per user (default 10)
- **daily_reset_hour** — UTC hour for daily counter reset (0–23)
- **ad_reward_enabled** — master on/off toggle
- **instant_reward** — credits coins instantly after ad watch
- **no_limit_mode** — when true, bypasses daily ad cap
- **ad_reward_tiers** — JSON tier array matching the app UI (1/3/5/10 coin tiers)

**Auth required:** Admin Bearer token

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}/admin/ad-reward-settings`

request.description:
Returns the full ad reward configuration used by the mobile app.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `coins_per_ad` | number | Coins per single ad watch |
| `max_ads_per_day` | number | Daily cap per user |
| `daily_reset_hour` | number | UTC hour for reset (0–23) |
| `ad_reward_enabled` | bool | Master on/off toggle |
| `instant_reward` | bool | Instant coin credit |
| `no_limit_mode` | bool | Bypass daily cap |
| `ad_reward_tiers` | array | Tier configs shown in app UI |
